name: FuelWell Pilot Decision Engine
description: Tracks whether pilots see, trust, follow, and return from FuelWell recommendations.
refresh: daily during TestFlight, weekly after pilot week one

insights.title: Recommendation Dismissal Reasons
insights.target: No single reason exceeds 40% of dismissals for a week

insights.title: Primary Tab Interest
insights.target: Coach and Meals tabs both receive repeat visits

pilot_review_questions: Are pilots following recommendations or only reading them?
Which recommendation category creates the most dismissals?
Do proactive nudges bring pilots back into the app?
Does feedback completion break on any route?
Are pilots using Coach after logging meals?
